evaluator: Model visual judgment from original rendered screenshots and instrumented interaction, not a human usability study.
scope: Visual clarity of Robot setup, Operate, Record and Replay; preserve supported behavior.
gates: Default setup has no repeated instructional paragraphs.
A visually distinct primary action is present when applicable.
Simulation has no permanent explanatory side panel.
Real robot capability limits and actionable errors remain visible.
Help and diagnostics can be expanded and dismissed.
Primary controls fit 1024x768 and 1440x900 in both themes.
Simulation record/save/replay and flexible layouts continue to work.

baseline.basis: Current rendered real Nano setup: duplicated capability paragraphs, unprioritized buttons, long diagnostic sidebar and excessive header height.
